deltalake 1.6.1's load_as_version(timestamp) races with millisecond-resolution commit timestamps: when the pin timestamp equals the exact write time of the v0 commit, it can round to the next commit instead, so pinned.version becomes 1 instead of 0. Reproduced locally in isolation (pyarrow/deltalake only, no Django): 20/30 runs of the write->overwrite->load_as_version sequence landed one version past v0. This PR only touches the MongoDB source (mongo.py/test_mongo.py) and never imports warehouse_parent.py, so the timing race is pre-existing and unrelated.
